events.title: Be Healthy Bash
events.description:
UK HealthCare and UK Cooperative Extension Service present the Be Healthy Bash.

Eat, play and kick off fall with our free family-friendly health and wellness festival. The Be Healthy Bash is open to the public and will take place rain or shine...

events.title: Antagonist Productions: "Velvet Revival"
events.description: Velvet Revival is a new production in Lexington featuring sultry and energetic jazz music, dance, and circus performance. The emcee invites you to escape the world and enter a Prohibition era jazz club for unforgettable entertainment.
